tools.name: list_shelves
tools.description: Every shelf (African FX data + services) with price in USD, params, and how to pay. Payment is x402 (USDC on Base, settled by Coinbase). Free to call.

tools.name: buy_shelf
tools.description: Creates a Coinbase checkout for one shelf and returns: x402_url (pay it with any x402 client — gasless USDC on Base), pay_url (for a human), and claim_url (GET it after paying to receive the delivery). Does not move money itself.

tools.name: get_order
tools.description: Returns the order status; once Coinbase reports the payment COMPLETED the delivery is included.
